@@ -513,6 +522,50 @@ mod SelfhostDecl do
     end
   end
 
+  # `case SCRUT do <nl> PAT [when G] -> BODY <nl> … end` — the scrutinee, then
+  # newline-separated arms up to `end`. Each arm is a pattern, an optional `when`
+  # guard, `->`, and a single-expression body (parse_bp stops at the next `<nl>`/
+  # `end`/`->`). Projects to Rian.Pratt's `{:case, scrut, [{pat, guard|nil, body}]}`.
+  def parse_case(ts Vec(Tok)) Parse
+  def parse_case(ts)
+    case parse_bp(0, ts) do
+      P(scrut, [TKw("do") | r2]) ->
+        case parse_arms(r2, []) do
+          ARs(arms, r3) -> parse_postfix(Case(scrut, arms), r3)
+        end
+    end
+  end
+
+  def parse_arms(ts Vec(Tok), acc Vec(CaseArm)) ArmsRes
+  def parse_arms([TNL | rest], acc) := parse_arms(rest, acc)
+  def parse_arms([TKw("end") | rest], acc) := ARs(rev_arms(acc, []), rest)
+  def parse_arms(ts, acc)
+    case parse_arm(ts) do
+      AR(arm, rest) -> parse_arms(rest, [arm | acc])
+    end
+  end
+
+  def parse_arm(ts Vec(Tok)) ArmRes
+  def parse_arm(ts)
+    case parse_pat(ts) do
+      PP(pat, [TKw("when") | r1]) ->
+        case parse_bp(0, r1) do
+          P(g, [TOp("->") | r2]) ->
+            case parse_bp(0, r2) do
+              P(body, r3) -> AR(CArmG(pat, g, body), r3)
+            end
+        end
+      PP(pat, [TOp("->") | r1]) ->
+        case parse_bp(0, r1) do
+          P(body, r2) -> AR(CArm(pat, body), r2)
+        end
+    end
+  end
+
+  def rev_arms(Vec(CaseArm), Vec(CaseArm)) Vec(CaseArm)
+  def rev_arms([], out) := out
+  def rev_arms([a | rest], out) := rev_arms(rest, [a | out])
+
   # list construction as a nil/cons chain (mirrors parse_list_pat): `[x | acc]` ->
   # ConsE(x, acc); elements are full expressions.
   def parse_list_expr(ts Vec(Tok)) Parse

@@ -112,6 +112,13 @@ defmodule Rian.DeclFixpointTest do

+  # the front-end's `Case(scrut, arms)` projects onto Rian.Pratt's
+  # `{:case, scrut, [{pat, guard | nil, body}, …]}` — single-expr arm bodies.

+  defp carm({:c_arm, pat, body}), do: {cp(pat), nil, ce(body)}

+
   defp ce(leaf), do: leaf
